bibliographic_correction: The supplied manuscript prints the issue-wide page range 2801–3294. INFORMS gives article pages 3133–3141.

dependent_variables: Change in operating income after depreciation
original_future_performance_test.posting_measure: Change in average active postings during the first three months of fiscal t+1 relative to the corresponding months of t, scaled by assets[t], then ranked following the manuscript’s convention
controls: lagged asset-scaled change in capital expenditure

our_proposed_extension.design: Signal recovery: construct original and ghost-adjusted posting counts, then apply the same Lourie future-activity specification to each signal.
our_proposed_extension.adjustment: Remove individually linked ghost postings when such links are available. With only an aggregate measure, N_adj[i,w] = N_raw[i,w]*(1-q_hat[i,w]) is a proxy adjustment requiring an explicit mapping from the review population to the posting population.
our_proposed_extension.measurement_warning: An interview-review share is not automatically the fraction of advertised vacancies that are ghost jobs. Raw feature scores are not calibrated posting probabilities.
our_proposed_extension.posting_change_construction: Adjust the level of postings in each time window first; average active postings over the first three months, compare the corresponding windows one year apart, then apply benchmark asset scaling and ranking. Do not multiply the already-computed posting change by a single current ghost share.
our_proposed_extension.equation: DeltaY[i,t+1] = alpha_m + beta_m*P_m[i,t+3m] + theta_m*X[i,t] + industry FE_m + year FE_m + error_m, for m in {raw, adjusted}
our_proposed_extension.prediction: The adjusted hiring signal should reproduce the positive relations with employment, SG&A, revenue, and operating earnings. Preferably it improves correspondence with realized activity relative to the original signal.
our_proposed_extension.information_timing: Use only ghost evidence available by each relevant measurement date. Fix classification and discounting rules independently of future outcomes; avoid full-sample priors that contain future reviews.
our_proposed_extension.comparison: Use the same firms, periods, outcome definitions, controls, effects and clustering for original and adjusted signals. Report confidence intervals and comparable-unit estimates; assess predictive correspondence on a prespecified held-out sample. A bigger coefficient or a smaller p-value alone is not sufficient.
our_proposed_extension.primary_test_is_not: An interaction between raw posting changes and ghost intensity, or a regression of future outcomes on ghost intensity alone.
our_proposed_extension.caveat: Recovery of the expected hiring pattern is evidence consistent with the measure, alongside independent coding and external hiring checks, rather than proof about every vacancy.

additional_external_check: Matched hires per posting over six months by company, occupation/role, seniority and location, following the logic described in Revelio’s article; separate common review-source evidence from independent worker-start evidence.
data_needed: Time-stamped active-posting counts and identifiers aligned to the financial firm, including corresponding three-month windows in adjacent fiscal years and a defensible link to the ghost measure
Posting opening/closing dates, occupation/skills and geography for duration and composition checks
Worker position starts for independent hiring-conversion checks
Independent human labels of narratives for classification precision/recall
data_currently_supplied: Annual financial statements and selected analyst/ownership files
not_substitutes: Interview-review counts are not active-posting counts
Compustat net employment change is not gross hiring or departures
A significant or insignificant investment coefficient does not validate ghost-job identification
user_confirmed_validation_logic: Identify and remove or discount suspected ghost jobs, then test whether the remaining hiring signal reproduces the positive Lourie posting-to-hiring/performance results.
